question: Find the ANTONYM of the word ‘halt’ from the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"halt"** which means to bring or come to a stop, or to cease moving. (ठहरना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The construction work had to halt temporarily due to the unexpected rainfall.*
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is **"trigger"** which means to cause something to happen or to initiate a process. (चालू कर देना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The sudden noise outside triggered his anxiety.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **"trigger".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hides**: It means to keep something out of sight or to cover it up. (छिपाना)
 
• **Trafficking**: It refers to the illegal trade or movement of goods, often involving smuggling. (तस्करी)
 
• **Captive**: It refers to being confined or imprisoned, particularly in the context of animals. (कैदी)
